Hi John / AP team —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. We're getting ready to add ArcCloud as an approved vendor so our procurement and finance teams can issue POs and pay invoices. To get the vendor record created without delays, can you please provide the items below by end of day Friday (2026-06-14)?

Required (please send as attachments or via the secure upload link below):
- Legal business name exactly as it appears on tax filings
- W-9 (completed and signed) or applicable tax form for non-US entities
- Remit-to address (street, city, state/province, postal code, country)
- Remit contact name + email for invoice questions
- Preferred payment method: ACH or Wire (if ACH, we need banking info below)
- ACH details: bank name, account type, routing number, account number, account holder name, and a voided check or bank letter if possible

Optional/helpful:
- Any PO number rules or invoice references you require (e.g., project codes)
- Any vendor master notes we should store (tax status, terms exceptions)

For security, use our secure upload portal for banking docs: https://redwood-secure-upload.company/for/arccloud/12345
(If you prefer DocuSign or another encrypted channel, let me know and we can accommodate.)

Attaching our vendor intake template and Redwood ACH form (fillable PDF). I'll loop in Monica from Finance to confirm once we have the docs.

Thanks — looking to get this completed quickly so we can process the first PO next week.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Stephanie / John —

Received the W-9; looks good at a glance. For Redwood vendor creation we require the following before we can activate payment terms in the AP system:
- Completed W-9 (received)
- Completed Redwood ACH form with bank ACH details (signed) + voided check or bank letter (preferred)
- Remit-to address that matches the W-9 legal name (John provided this)
- Vendor contact for invoice escalation (Alyssa ok)

John — please upload the signed ACH form and a voided check to our secure portal: https://redwood-secure-upload.company/for/arccloud/12345. Once uploaded, reply here so I can pull the documents and run the vendor verification (name match, EIN validation).

A couple of notes on PO flow:
- Standard payment term is Net 30 unless you have an approved exception.
- PO numbers are required on all invoices; if you need a specific project code included, share that and we'll add it to the master notes.

Once I verify the bank info, I will:
1) Create the vendor master record
2) Assign vendor ID and default payment method (ACH)
3) Confirm when the vendor is active and eligible to receive POs/payments

Estimated timeline after docs received: 1–2 business days for verification.

Thanks,
